senses.def: a light strong brittle grey toxic bivalent metallic element
have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun)
ex: John is rich
This is not a good answer

senses.def: be identical to; be someone or something
ex: The president of the company is John Smith
This is my house

senses.def: occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere
ex: Where is my umbrella?
The toolshed is in the back

senses.def: have an existence, be extant
ex: Is there a God?

senses.def: be identical or equivalent to
ex: One dollar equals 1,000 rubles these days!

senses.def: form or compose
ex: This money is my only income
The stone wall was the backdrop for the performance

senses.def: work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function
ex: He is a herpetologist
She is our resident philosopher

senses.def: represent, as of a character on stage
ex: Derek Jacobi was Hamlet

senses.def: spend or use time
ex: I may be an hour

senses.def: have life, be alive
ex: Our great leader is no more
My grandfather lived until the end of war

senses.def: to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted — used only in infinitive form
ex: let her be

senses.def: be priced at
ex: These shoes cost $100

senses.def: Used with past participles of verbs to form the passive voice.
ex: The dog was saved by the boy.

senses.def: Used with to-infinitives of verbs to express intent, obligation, appropriateness, or relative future occurrence.
ex: I am to leave tomorrow.
They are to stay here until I return.

senses.def: To tend to do, often do; marks the habitual aspect.
ex:
1996, David Sheffield, Barry W. Blaustein, Tom Shadyac and Steve Oedekerk, screenplay of The Nutty Professor
Women be shoppin’! You cannot stop a woman from shoppin’!

senses.def: To exist.
ex: There is just one woman in town who can help us.
(or, dialectally:) It is just one woman in town who can help us.

senses.def: Used to declare the subject and object identical or equivalent.
ex: Hi, I’m Jim.
3 times 5 is fifteen.

senses.def: Used to indicate that a predicate nominal applies to the subject.
ex: Rex is a dog.
A dog is an animal.

senses.def: Used to indicate that the subject has the qualities described by an adjective or prepositional phrase.
ex: The sky is blue.

senses.def: Used to link a subject to a measurement.
ex: This building is three hundred years old.
I am 75 kilograms.

senses.def: Used to state the age of a subject in years.
ex: I’m 20 (years old).

senses.def: Used to indicate the time of day.
ex: It is almost eight (o’clock).
It’s 8:30 [read eight-thirty] in Tokyo.

senses.def: Used to indicate passage of time since the occurrence of an event.
ex: It has been three years since my grandmother died. (similar to "My grandmother died three years ago", but emphasizes the intervening period)
It had been six days since his departure, when I received a letter from him.

senses.def: Used to link two noun clauses: a day of the week, recurring date, month, or other specific time (on which the event of the main clause took place) and a period of time indicating how long ago that day was.
ex: I saw her Monday was a week: I saw her a week ago last Monday (a week before last Monday).
On the morning of Sunday was fortnight before Christmas: on the morning of the Sunday that was two weeks before the Sunday prior to Christmas.

senses.def: To take a period of time.
ex: Dinner will be ten minutes.
It was an hour before he returned.

senses.def: Used to indicate ambient conditions such as weather, light, noise or air quality.
ex: It is hot in Arizona, but it is not usually humid.
Why is it so dark in here?

senses.def: To exist or behave in a certain way.
ex: When I get sad, I stop being sad and be awesome instead.
"What do we do?" "We be ourselves."

senses.def: To exist; to have real existence, to be alive.
ex: The Universe has no explanation: it just is.
That was the week that was.

senses.def: To remain undisturbed in a certain state or situation.
ex: Let them be for a few hours.
Leave us be until the guests arrive.

senses.def: To occupy a place.
ex: The cup is on the table.

senses.def: To occur, to take place.
ex: When will the meeting be?

senses.def: Elliptical form of “be here”, “go to and return from” or similar, also extending to certain other senses of “go”.
ex: The postman has been today, but my tickets have still not yet come.
I have been to Spain many times.

senses.def: The name of the Cyrillic script letter Б / б
